paragraphs: An open Salmonella outbreak linked to broccoli sprouts has sickened 32 people across six states, with three hospitalizations reported [1]. The E. coli outbreak previously associated with frozen blueberries is now over, affecting 17 people across two states [2].

Sempio Food Services Inc. is recalling ready-to-eat chicken stew products imported without proper inspection; affected boxes contain 31.75-oz pouches labeled "Sempio Korean Ginseng CHICKEN STEW CLASSIC" and were distributed to FL, GA, IL, MD, NJ, NY, PA, and VA [3]. Fontanini Foods LLC is recalling raw, frozen pork sausage links that may contain clear, hard plastic; the 10-lb boxes are marked "ITEM 393" with packing dates of 06/23/2026 and reached CA, FL, MI, and NV [4][18]. Star Meat Delivery Inc. is recalling vacuum-packed A&D Foods goat products produced without inspection [5].

Additional recalls include Deano's Pasta Pear and Pecorino Triangoli Ravioli due to undeclared lobster that poses serious allergic reaction risk to those sensitive to crustacean shellfish [7][16]. Galil Importing Corp is recalling Lior Cinnamon Ground Seasoning for elevated lead levels [8][17]. G. L. Mezzetta Inc. is recalling specific lots of Golden Greek Peperoncini Medium Heat (32-ounce) due to pest contamination [6]. Berlin Seeds is recalling alfalfa sprouting seed that may be contaminated with Shiga toxin-producing E. coli or Salmonella [9].
